author: Cleo Abram
description:
What’s happening right now is a big deal.
For more HUGE* Conversations with the most important leaders in science and tech, subscribe!

The biggest AI launch since ChatGPT just happened... and Alexandr Wang and his team at Meta built it. 

Most people are using AI to answer questions, glorified Google Search.
This is something totally different. It’s an "agent." It can make phonecalls, do tasks, for you.

But for it to work, you have to trust it. First with your personal information. Then that it’s going to do what you actually want. And then that it’s not gonna, well, get out of control. All at a time when the people building the most powerful AI leaders are warning us that AI IS getting out of control!

If you understand Muse, you’ll understand the biggest open questions about AI right now. 

In this HUGE* Conversation with Meta AI Chief Alexandr Wang, that's what we do.

What can Muse actually do? When can we trust it? And what should we do to make sure this goes right?

Chapters:
title: What Can Meta’s Muse Actually Do?

description:
The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Francis Halzen! His discovery required an enormous telescope buried deep in the Antarctic ice...

The idea started way back in the 1980s as an ambitious idea, by 2010, with the help of hundreds of other scientists, the concept became reality. By 2017, his work leading this monumental effort had opened the door to an entirely new era of astronomy.

For more, subscribe!
